newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul foreign exchange market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Seoul foreign exchange market closed for holiday.

text.p: Seoul's won-dollar market was closed for Children's Day on Monday. The market will reopen on Tuesday.
On Friday, the won closed at 893.10, compared with Wednesday's closing of 891.90. It opened at 891.60 and moved between 890.60 and 893.30. The market was closed on Thursday for Labour Day.
The won's mid-rate is expected to be pegged at 892.10 on Tuesday, compared with 892.20 on Friday.
